requirements.requirement: The individual whose full name is requested is the third child out of five born to a mother named Johanna and a father named Christian.
As a child, this individual often had to hide away to immerse themselves in books, even crafting a candlestick out of clay so they could read and learn in their secret spot at night.
At one point in their career, this individual faced financial struggles and began taking on translation work to earn extra income.
This individual passed away wealthy sometime after 1820 but before 1880.
